name: lume-demo-ui
description: Client runtime for the Lume demo: real React + TypeScript, bundled by esbuild and styled with Tailwind CSS into ../www (the framework docroot).

scripts.build:js: esbuild src/invest/app.tsx src/invest/dashboard.tsx src/invest/reports.tsx src/invest/settings.tsx src/hub/hub-home.tsx src/hub/hub-catalog.tsx src/hub/hub-discovery.tsx --bundle --minify --format=esm --splitting --outdir=../www --outbase=src
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build:js && pnpm run build:css
scripts.build:items: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build:items:js && pnpm run build:items:css
scripts.dev:js: esbuild src/invest/app.tsx src/invest/dashboard.tsx src/invest/reports.tsx src/invest/settings.tsx src/hub/hub-home.tsx src/hub/hub-catalog.tsx src/hub/hub-discovery.tsx --bundle --format=esm --splitting --outdir=../www --outbase=src --watch
scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:js & pnpm run dev:items:js & pnpm run dev:items:css & pnpm run dev:css & wait
scripts.dev:items: pnpm run dev:items:js & pnpm run dev:items:css & wait
